architecture.rationale: Ownership remains with each existing overlay host and presenter; the corrected complete-cleanup rule is documented in the owning module.

tutorial.rationale: Normal overlay declarations and lifecycle usage are unchanged.

guide.rationale: The guide still uses the same declaration API; exceptional cleanup behavior is documented by the owning host.

migration.rationale: Corrects cleanup after failure without changing public signatures or normal dismissal semantics.

redirect.rationale: No symbol identity, package, owner, or documentation route moves.
